description.content:
Comma-separated list of fields to return.

**Available fields:**
- `id` - Unique identifier
- `name` - Todo name
- `description` - Optional description
- `completed` - Completion status
- `created_at` - Creation timestamp
- `updated_at` - Last update timestamp

**Examples:**
- `?fields=id,name` - Only ID and name
- `?fields=id,name,completed` - ID, name, and status
- No parameter returns all fields

**Available fields:**
- `id` - Unique identifier (public)
- `username` - Username (public)
- `email` - Email address (public)
- `created_at` - Creation timestamp (public)
- `updated_at` - Last update timestamp (public)

**Examples:**
- `?fields=id,username` - Only ID and username
- `?fields=id,username,email` - Include email
- No parameter returns all accessible fields
